items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Because he said, “Well Jackie, you guys took a picture and I didn’t know you guys—”

ctx.x: With that cigar in his mouth.

Well that was a thrill automatically with just those two guys. The thing is, John Bunch said, “Well you guys took a picture and I went home.” John Bunch was supposed to be in this picture. Yes. Because he said, “Well Jackie, you guys took a picture and I didn’t know you guys—” I said, “Well I didn’t know either,” nobody told me until after, see I had my coat on, and they said, “Well come on.” I thought I was ready to go and they said, “Well come on we got to take a picture.” Well we had all met — Hank called and…

players but this is the one where everybody played — different age groups. Yeah. He’s so fabulous. We had a wonderful time doing this. While we were doing the session, Dizzy’s so comical, he was showing, he had this what do you call those things that they write down, you know like a memo book.
